# Load in libraries and data
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# loading libraries -------------------------------------------------------
  library(Seurat)
  library(CellChat)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(magrittr)
  library(patchwork)


# loading data ------------------------------------------------------------

CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human
longitudinal <- readRDS("../OBJECTS/Annotated_Longitudinal_Object_AH.rds")
```

# Organizing Metadata and Making Objects

## Creating treatment Naive and treated subsets --------------------------------------
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Idents(longitudinal) <- "Level1Labels"
levels(longitudinal)
DimPlot(longitudinal)
longitudinal$samples <- longitudinal$sample_id

integratedData.list <- SplitObject(longitudinal, split.by = "timepoint")
remove(longitudinal)

 # Creating CellChat Object ------------------------------------------------

assayUsed <- 'CorrectedCounts'
CellChat.list <- lapply(integratedData.list, function(x){
  CellChat_obj <- createCellChat(object = GetAssayData(x, assay = assayUsed, layer = "data"),
                                 meta = x@meta.data,
                                 group.by = "Level1Labels")
})
remove(integratedData.list)
```

# Running CellChat 
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
CellChat.list <- lapply(CellChat.list, function(x){
  x@DB <- CellChatDB
  cellchat <- subsetData(x)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat@meta$Level1Labels <- factor(cellchat@meta$Level1Labels)
  cellchat@meta$Level1Labels <- droplevels(cellchat@meta$Level1Labels,
                                            exclude = setdiff(levels(cellchat@meta$Level1Labels),unique(as.character(cellchat@meta$Level1Labels))))
  cellchat@idents <- cellchat@meta$Level1Labels
  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat)
  cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
  return(cellchat)
})
```

# Plotting CellChat
## Splitting objects
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
T1 <- CellChat.list[[2]] #timepoint 1
T2 <- CellChat.list[[1]] #timepoint 2
```

## Interaction Weight / Strength -------------------------------------------
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## cell-cell communication strength tables
T1@net$weight 
T2@net$weight 
```

## Plotting communication strength

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)
netVisual_circle(T1@net$weight, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(T1@idents)), arrow.size = 0.1,
                 weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "T1 interaction strength", margin = 0.01)
netVisual_circle(T2@net$weight, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(T2@idents)), arrow.size = 0.1,
                 weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "T2 interaction strength", margin = 0.01)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Compute the network cent=rality scores
T1 <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(T1, slot.name = "netP")
T2 <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(T2,slot.name = "netP")

pathways.show.all <- T1@netP$pathways #view all possible pathways 
pathways.show.all
levels(T1@idents)
```

# Analyzing chemokine pathways

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pathways <- c("CXCL", "CCL")

par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)

netVisual_chord_gene(T1, signaling = pathways, sources.use = c(2,3,4,5,6,13), targets.use = c(2,3,4,5,6,13), lab.cex = 0.5,legend.pos.y = 30)
netVisual_chord_gene(T2, signaling = pathways, sources.use = c(2,3,4,5,6,13), targets.use = c(2,3,4,5,6,13), lab.cex = 0.5,legend.pos.y = 30)
dev.off()


```
